links.outcome: Physician acceptance of AI outputs reported separately by site and across ultrasound vendors
links.effect: 86% of AI outputs accepted without modification overall (84% academic, 88% private); average processing time 1.15 s per cycle across diverse ultrasound vendors; r = 0.98 with expert measurements.
links.quote: Notably, physicians accepted 86% of the AI-generated outputs without modification (84% in the academic setting and 88% in the private sector), confirming the system's robust reliability and cross-domain adaptability.

unlisted_practices: Human-in-the-loop web interface letting physicians visualize and verify segmentation masks in real time

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical usability and clinician acceptance/interaction with a novel web-based AI echocardiography decision support platform across multiple centers.
